  Geolocated data has multiplied in recent years, whether
  it is open data or geolocated digital traces of the
  _big data_ type. For spatial data, the `GeoPandas` package
  extends the features of the `Pandas` ecosystem to make it possible
  to handle complex geographic data in a simple way.
